title: Sky Lodge Christian Camp

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: When your child comes for a week of overnight camp at Sky Lodge in Montello, Wisconsin - less than an hour from Madison, they will find a place to grow by exploring the great outdoors and encountering the God who created it all. Engaging with creation might look like paddling a canoe, fishing with our cane poles, taking a horseback trail ride, learning to shoot an arrow, or playing team games on our spacious yard. When campers come to Sky Lodge Christian Camp, they leave their devices at home so they have space to be curious - to notice the world and people around them.
